patch: UPDATE tax_data SET field_value = '90000' WHERE field_name = 'w2_gross_wages' AND return_id IN (SELECT id FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2025)
UPDATE tax_data SET field_value = '18000' WHERE field_name = 'w2_federal_withheld' AND return_id IN (SELECT id FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2025)

UPDATE tax_documents SET data_json = replace(replace(data_json, '"wages": "142000"', '"wages": "90000"'), '"federal_tax_withheld": "28400"', '"federal_tax_withheld": "18000"') WHERE lower(doc_type) LIKE '%w2%' AND return_id IN (SELECT id FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2025)
